jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Our customers deserve banking that fits their lives, not the other way around. As Tribe Lead for the Cards & Financing Platform tribe, you will lead an organisation dedicated to enabling intuitive, embedded, and tailored offerings across cards and financing. This is a rare opportunity to lead at scale within a team that puts customers at the center of every decision.

**Overview Of Danske Bank

**Danske Bank is a leading Nordic financial services group dedicated to strengthening its position in the market by delivering innovative, resilient, and sustainable core capabilities. The mission of the Cards & Financing Platform tribe focuses on enhancing customer experiences across all markets with offerings in mortgages, lending, cards, and branch services, including core financing capabilities supporting Realkredit Danmark, in close collaboration with sister tribes responsible for our customer-facing offerings.

We prioritise sustainability and have refined our organisational structure into focused tribes, each led by experts in their respective fields. The Cards & Financing Platform is a vital component, encompassing approximately 280 colleagues across more than 20 squads primarily located in Denmark, India and Lithuania, all committed to advancing our Forward '28 strategy.

**What You Will Be Doing

**You will co-lead the Cards & Financing Platform tribe together with the Tribe Leadership Team, which includes an IT Lead, Tribe Coach, and Tribe Architect. All Product Owners and leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads) will report to you, making your leadership central to how the tribe collaborates and delivers on the Danske Bank Forward '28 strategy.

More specifically, you will:

• Use your domain expertise to guide Product Owners and Business Chapter Leads on roadmap priorities, key business decisions and the tribe backlog

• Lead strategy, Annual Business Reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews across the tribe

• Engage senior stakeholders to align on priorities, dependencies, and major decisions

• Engage with large international vendors as part of the tribe's delivery commitments

• Act as HR manager for Product Owners, leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads), Business Manager, and Management Coordinator

• Drive tribe performance across delivery, adoption, business outcomes, efficiency, and cost, working closely with commercial stakeholders to realise the value of existing and new solutions

• Drive the development and implementation of GenAI solutions and embed AI-enabled ways of working across the tribe to improve productivity, quality, and customer and business outcomes.

• Drive the tribe’s risk and compliance agenda and, together with the Tribe Leadership Team, advance platform modernisation while maintaining reliable end-to-end services.

**About You

**

• Solid experience leading large, cross-functional technology or product organisations

• Strong domain expertise in cards and financing, with a solid understanding of the underlying products, processes and core platforms, and a genuine interest in technology

• Ability to translate strategic direction into clear priorities and communicate them accessibly

• Track record of delivering solutions that improve customer experiences

• Skilled at building agile, collaborative cultures where colleagues feel trusted and supported

• Skilled at engaging with senior leaders and managing complex stakeholder relationships

• Open to continuous personal and professional development

**What We Offer You

**You will join the organisation at an important moment, with real responsibility and genuine trust from the start. The role is hybrid, with three to four days per week in the office in Copenhagen to support collaboration and knowledge sharing across a geographically spread tribe. You will have room to develop your own skills while supporting your colleagues to do the same, within a team that values openness, belonging, and shared learning.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Hiring Manager Mark Wraa-Hansen (mark.wraa.hansen@danskebank.dk) head of Personal Banking DK. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply at your earliest convenience or by 23.11.26 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Join us in this role where you’ll own and continuously develop our fundamental view of European power markets. Working at the intersection of market analysis and trading, you’ll bring together insights from across the organisation, form an independent view of where markets are heading, and translate this into clear commercial recommendations.

Working closely with the Trading & Revenue senior leadership, trading desk heads, and traders, you’ll influence decisions around trading strategies, hedging, portfolio management, and PPAs. Rather than supporting decisions from a distance, you’ll be a trusted market expert whose analysis and judgement help shape the positions we take.

**Welcome to Trading & Revenue

**You’ll be part of Forecasting & Analysis where you, together with your colleagues, will provide the market insights and analysis behind key trading and commercial decisions.   You’ll work in a dynamic environment close to the trade floor, collaborating with traders, analysts, meteorologists, and dedicated in-house model developers. With strong modelling capabilities around you, you’ll be able to focus on interpreting what is happening in the market, challenging existing assumptions, forming a strong fundamental view, and translating it into commercial opportunities.

As a team, we challenge our thinking, share our expertise openly, and combine different perspectives to make better decisions.

In this role, your analysis becomes action. You’ll engage directly with Trading & Revenue senior leadership team and have the opportunity to shape how we understand European power markets. You’ll play a leading role in strengthening our market analysis capability, bringing in external perspectives and best practices, and developing a more integrated view across Trading & Revenue.

You’ll play an important role in:

• owning, developing, and maintaining our fundamental view of European power markets, with a particular focus on North-Western Europe and the UK, and bringing together perspectives from across Trading & Revenue into a coherent market outlook

• acting as a trusted sparring partner to the Trading & Revenue senior leadership, trading desk heads, traders, and portfolio managers, bringing an independent fundamental market perspective to key strategic and commercial decisions

• identifying structural and emerging shifts across supply, demand, regulation, weather, generation, interconnector flows, electrification, and other market drivers, and assessing what they mean for power prices and market dynamics

• turning market developments into commercial implications, from understanding the impact of changing generation availability or demand assumptions to assessing what these developments mean for our portfolios and trading positions

• translating fundamental market insights into actionable trading and hedging strategies together with our trading teams, helping facilitate discussions on what positions we should take as market conditions and assumptions evolve

• advising senior stakeholders on the market implications of important portfolio, PPA, and other commercial decisions, bringing a clear view of both market opportunities and risks

• advancing our fundamental power market capability by bringing together perspectives from across the organisation, introducing external insights and industry best practices, and strengthening how we form and communicate our market view across Trading & Revenue.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have deep expertise in European power markets and significant experience forming an independent view of how fundamental developments affect power prices and market dynamics

• bring strong commercial judgement and can move confidently from fundamental analysis to clear recommendations on trading, hedging, portfolio, and PPA decisions

• understand the interaction between physical power market fundamentals, forward markets, options, and curve dynamics, and can connect changes in the physical market with their commercial and trading implications

• are comfortable owning a market view, challenging established assumptions, and acting as an equal sparring partner to experienced traders and senior decision-makers

• can look beyond established market assumptions, identify developments or structural shifts that may not yet be fully reflected in the market view, and determine what they could mean for future power prices

• can bring together different sources of analysis, modelling, external intelligence, and perspectives from across the organisation to form a clear and coherent market view

• communicate complex market developments as concise, decisive, and commercially relevant recommendations, including to senior stakeholders

• bring substantial experience from power or closely related European energy markets, whether gained in a utility, trading environment, financial institution, or similar market-facing organization.

jobs.description:
**Shape the engineering solutions behind vaccines that protect lives every day

**Are you an experienced bioprocess engineer who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to set direction and bring people together?

Join Bavarian Nordic and take a leading role in shaping the processes and systems that support our Drug Substance manufacturing.

From major capital projects and technology transfers to solving complex manufacturing challenges, you will help ensure our processes are robust, scalable, and ready for reliable operation.

**Your impact

**As Senior Engineering Specialist, you will serve as a technical authority for integrated bioprocess systems across process engineering, automation, filtration, and equipment design.

You will guide critical technical decisions throughout the manufacturing lifecycle—from concept and scale-up through qualification, validation, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad technical responsibility and influence across functions and projects. You will lead technical workstreams and mentor experienced engineers without formal line-management responsibility.

**What You Will Do

**Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, Quality, Validation, and external partners, you will:

• Lead bioprocess design and optimization: Set the technical direction for upstream and downstream processes, purification, bulk formulation, and sterile transfers. Use process knowledge, modelling, and manufacturing data to improve yield, capacity, reliability, and product quality.

• Shape automation and control strategies: Translate process needs into requirements for PLC/DCS and SCADA systems, recipes, sequences, interlocks, and alarms. Ensure solutions support effective process control, data integrity, and reliable operation.

• Provide technical leadership for filtration: Define filter selection, sizing, validation, and integrity-testing strategies for liquid and gas systems. Lead investigations into filter failures, pressure deviations, and performance issues.

• Guide equipment and system design: Review and approve tanks, piping, pumps, valves, and instrumentation, including hydraulic calculations, pressure distribution, and pressure-testing strategies. Lead technical decisions for Cleaning-in-Place and Sterilization-in-Place (CIP/SIP) systems.

• Deliver projects and technology transfers: Lead process engineering activities from concept and vendor selection through factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, process validation, and handover to operations.

• Strengthen technical standards and compliance: Resolve complex investigations, support change controls and CAPAs, and represent engineering during audits and inspections. Establish reusable design standards and share knowledge across projects and teams.

**What You Bring

**You have a master’s degree or PhD in Bioengineering, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

You bring substantial industrial experience, typically 15 years or more, including at least 10 years within pharmaceutical, biotechnology or vaccine manufacturing.

Your experience includes:

• Leading complex engineering projects as a lead engineer or technical authority, with hands-on expertise in bioprocess development, scale-up, commercial manufacturing, and lifecycle management.

• Integrating process equipment with automation and SCADA systems, including control strategies, computerized-system validation, and data integrity.

• Designing and validating filtration systems, including filter integrity testing and pressure/flow troubleshooting.

• Working with hygienic tanks and piping, hydraulic calculations, pressure testing, CIP/SIP, and contamination control.

• Leading commissioning, qualification, process validation, Process Performance Qualification, and technology transfer, supported by a strong understanding of GMP and quality risk management.

• Setting technical standards, mentoring experienced engineers, and influencing decisions across functions without relying on formal authority.

**How You Work

**You combine scientific depth with practical engineering judgement. You can move from detailed technical analysis to clear recommendations that help colleagues and leaders make informed decisions.

You take ownership, challenge assumptions constructively, and remain focused when problems span multiple systems or disciplines. Whether working with operators, specialists, suppliers, or senior stakeholders, you communicate clearly and build trust through sound decisions and consistent follow-through.

You also enjoy developing others. Sharing expertise, coaching colleagues, and creating common standards are natural parts of how you work.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, we work to protect lives through vaccines. In this role, you will help build and improve the manufacturing capabilities that make that purpose possible.

You will have the opportunity to influence major technical decisions, strengthen engineering practices, and see your work translate into measurable improvements in manufacturing performance and reliable supply.

Our values—Persisting Pioneers, Embracing Change, and Boosted by the Team—shape how we collaborate and solve challenges. For the right candidate, sustained performance may open opportunities for broader engineering leadership or formal people management.

**Ready to shape the future of our Drug Substance manufacturing?

**We look forward to receiving your application and learning how your technical expertise and leadership could strengthen Bavarian Nordic.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

Genmab is seeking an experienced (Senior) Clinical Drug Supply Manager to join Global Clinical Drug Supply (GCDS) Manufacturing in Copenhagen.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials. In addition, this position offers significant influence over the refinement of Genmab’s processes, both within the GCDS Manufacturing function and cross-functionally to ensure scalability.

The (Senior) Clinical Drug Supply Manager will resolve complex operational challenges, lead strategic initiatives and mentor colleagues. A key focus of this role will be supporting team members through troubleshooting, problem-solving, and developing mitigation plans for complex issues related to packaging and labelling activities. This role requires balancing urgency and importance in a dynamic environment while serving as a positive role model for the team, by bringing a strong can-do attitude to drive solutions and inspire others.

The position reports to the Associate Director, Team Lead, Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing based in Princeton.

**Responsibilities

**Responsibilities will be adjusted based on level of experience, and may include the following:

• Manage operational trial and project objectives related to packaging and labelling, providing proactive oversight to meet goals.

• Oversee inspection readiness and ensure compliance with relevant GMP, GDP and GCP regulations.

• Engage with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful collaboration.

• Supervise and monitor vendor performance, ensuring delivery aligns with timelines and SOW.

• Provide direct support to team members in troubleshooting and problem resolution, ensuring effective development of mitigation plans for operational challenges.

• Mentor and coach team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.

• Lead complex GCDS Manufacturing projects within the area of clinical drug supply management.

• Develop, maintain and implement SOPs for drug supply processes and manage cross-functional collaborations.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant area (e.g., pharma, science, engineering, or supply chain management).

• Minimum 3 years of experience at manager level, and minimum 6+ years’ experience for Senior Manager. Ideally demonstrated skills with global CMO vendor collaboration and oversight of clinical packaging and labelling activities.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects with an innovative and entrepreneurial mindset.

• Collaborative, proactive, and goal-oriented team player who inspires colleagues while fostering strong relationships.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Extensive knowledge of GMP, GDP, and GCP regulations.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both oral and written.

**The Team

**You will join a highly competent team focused on packaging and labelling clinical trial supplies, collaborating closely with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Execution team. Together with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Systems team and Global Clinical Drug Supply Strategy team, these four functions form the Global Clinical Drug Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.

**Application

**If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter outlining your motivation for the position. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and interviews will be scheduled accordingly. Please note, fully remote applicants will not be considered; candidates must be within commuting distance of Copenhagen.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK687.888,00---1.031.832,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

**Our purpose

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

**What You'll Do

**

• Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

**Success looks like

**

• First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

**What You'll Bring With You

****Critical competencies

**

• Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

**Experience We Would Like To See

**We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• Some exposure to automated testing

• Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

**How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

**We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

**At Planday, we offer you
